children: Overview
France medical device maker's H1 2026 revenue fell 32% yr/yr due to U.S. business model shift
Net loss widened, impacted by asset sale costs and deferral of proceeds
European sales grew 17% in H1 2026, offsetting some U.S. revenue decline
Outlook
SpineGuard aims to achieve operational breakeven in the fourth qtr of 2026
Company expects improved operating income by end-2026 due to U.S. distribution model shift
SpineGuard projects sufficient financing through Q2 2027 based on business and financial forecasts
Result Drivers
U.S. BUSINESS MODEL SHIFT - Co said transition from direct sales to distribution in U.S. drove revenue and gross margin decline, with pricing effect and inventory build-up by Omnia Medical
ASSET SALE COSTS - Co said costs related to sale of U.S. subsidiary assets and deferral of proceeds under IFRS 15 impacted net loss
EUROPEAN SALES MOMENTUM - Co said strong sales momentum in Europe with 17% growth helped offset some U.S. revenue decline
